title: National & International Sports Honors (Jan–March 2026 Consolidated)
summary: India won ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 (1st back-to-back & home soil win) and U19 Cricket World Cup (6th title); Vidarbha won Vijay Hazare Trophy.

items: **ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026 (10th Edition):** India beat New Zealand by 96 runs in the final on **8 March 2026** (International Women’s Day) at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad. Captain: **Suryakumar Yadav**; Player of the Match: **Jasprit Bumrah**; Player of the Tournament: **Sanju Samson**.

**T20 World Cup Historic Milestones:** India became the **1st team to win back-to-back T20 WC titles** and the **1st team to win on home soil** (previous India triumphs: 2007 under MS Dhoni in South Africa, 2024 under Rohit Sharma in West Indies/USA).
**ICC U-19 Men’s Cricket World Cup:** India clinched a record **6th title**; Vaibhav Suryavanshi named Player of the Match and Player of the Series.
**Women’s Premier League (WPL 2026):** Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) won the championship title.
**Winter Olympics 2026 (Milan-Cortina, Italy):** Norway topped the official medal leaderboard.
**Domestic Cricket — Vijay Hazare Trophy:** Vidarbha defeated Karnataka to win their **maiden Vijay Hazare title**.
**Khelo India Multi-Sport Events:** **6th Khelo India Winter Games** hosted in Ladakh; **2nd Khelo India Beach Games** hosted in Dadra & Nagar Haveli.

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Double-first milestone (home-soil + back-to-back T20 World Cup titles); India's 6th U-19 title; Vidarbha's maiden Vijay Hazare title.
